scenes.outline: Household workers; A copies ear-to-wall as listening to house wishes, B checking buzz; A covers and demands house agreement instead of wiring call.
Housemates; A copies patting as calming keys, B feeling for lumps; A covers and insists apology without looking.
Breakfast helpers; A copies lamp switching onto gravity control, then covers confusion and helps rescue while blaming toaster.
Housemates; A copies tea-label reading from novelty mug, summons demon; cookbook then lease establishes text diet, and A feeds mug writing to erase source.
Commuting housemates; A copies discarded cracked bowl as ghost place setting, then covers and redirects questions to instant food/travel cup and ghost drop-off.
Gallery coworkers; A copies brush-water bucket placement as managed tide, B corrects; B later identifies reception tank and A directs fetch without explaining fish.
Inventor and supporter; A copies holding receiver lid as warm-up, B preventing loose lid falling; signal of tomorrow date supports microphone test while A keeps probability covered.
Inventor and supporter; A copies leak tray as upward-rain capture, then uses actual rising drop and measured tray increments while keeping pressure forecast under tray.
Witnesses; A copies porter-directed nod as agreement, B corrects; A waits for admission shadow walked away from stationary chair before revealing door held.
Diners; A copies waiter signal as shared recognition of waving noodle, then covers and gets B confirmation before disclosing ordered lunch.
